يحتضنوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِنُوا (yaḥtaḍinū) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# يُحْتَضَنُوا (yuḥtaḍanū) /juħ.ta.dˤa.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
